# Pixel diorama recipe

Hand-made pixel sprites that stand like paper cut-outs in a lit, foggy miniature world, viewed from a high three-quarter angle through a tilt-shift lens. A toy set where every lamp casts a real shadow. Light is the subject.

## Concept

- A miniature set of boxes, planks and water, skinned with pixel-art textures. Flat low-resolution sprites on it receive light and cast shadows. The camera sits high and far, behind a tilt-shift band, so the world reads as a tabletop model.
- Practical lights (brazier, lantern, lamp on a post) throw soft pools and sprite shadows over the floor. Moonbeams, fog and fireflies hang in the air. Heavy bloom and vignette steer the eye to the warm spots.
- Core contrast: sprites stay flat, stepped and low-res, while camera, light, glow and particles move smoothly on every frame.
- Wrong direction: voxel game (no cubic characters); flat 2D pixel RPG (this set has depth and real light); photo of a real miniature (all textures are pixels).

## Rendering

- Single texel density. Draw every surface and sprite per pixel on small canvases and display with `image-rendering: pixelated`. Character about 34 x 50 px, drawn once per pose into an atlas, shown at 5-6x.
- Colour from ramps: 5 swatches chosen by brightness through a narrow 4 x 4 Bayer dither (dead zone about 0.22 on sprites, 0.45 on textures). Sprites get a 1 px outline mixed toward the ink.
- Set drawn once. Project boxes and planes (planks, stone quay, posts, water, ground) through one fixed high three-quarter camera into a single image; at runtime only a few layers move. Water = a pixel field of quantised ripples with warm light columns pointing at the camera.
- Light is baked and animated apart. Sprites are shaded cold from the sky and warm from the nearest flame as they are drawn. Each source then gets an additive radial glow that flickers (stands in for bloom) and a warm pool on the floor.
- Cheap post-processing: a pre-blurred copy of the set under a sharp copy, shown through a horizontal tilt-shift band (mask gradient), plus a static vignette. No per-frame blur.

## Palette

- Two temperatures: a big cold ambient (night blue, `--bulan`) against small warm practicals (`--api`, `--bara`). Practicals tell the story; ambient sets mood.
- `--utama`: hero costume and the key word in the dialogue box. It is the one saturated colour no set material uses, so the tiny sprite can be found in a wide shot.
- `--aksen`: UI metal. Frame, corner gems, name plate, title.
- Darkest value = warm ink `--tinta`, never pure black. Brightest value = the light source itself, bloomed.
- Set materials (wood, stone, water, moss) are mixed from fixed hues with `--latar`, so the world dims or brightens with the brand. Costume colours, fire and moon do not change.
- Text sits on a `--latar` band or `--latar-2` plate, in `--teks`, `--utama-di-latar` or `--aksen-di-latar`.

## Type

- `--font-judul`: Cormorant Garamond 700, capitals, wide tracking: 0.12em at 128 px (title card), 0.3em at 40 px (chapter label).
- `--font-isi`: Cormorant Garamond 500, roman and italic. Dialogue 48 px; narration 52 px italic; tagline 58 px italic.
- Dialogue box, 1180 x 226 px: dark translucent plate, thin metal border plus inner hairline, four diamond corner gems, name plate on the top edge. Text types in letter by letter over about 2.7 s. Narration = centred italic line on a soft dark band.
- Chapter label and title card are part of the grammar. Hold the title 2 s or more.

## Timing

Sprites step; everything else glides.
- Walk cycle: 4 frames at about 9-10 fps. Idle: 2 frames alternating at 1.4-1.5 Hz. Blink every 3-4 s. Pose changes are instant cuts.
- Light breathing: flicker = 1 + sum of three sines (about 13, 24, 7 rad/s), roughly +-15 %. A single level value drives the sprite's lantern, glow opacity and glow scale together. Lighting a lamp adds a 0.5 s flare (x1.6) that decays.
- Shadow jump when a lamp is lit: the sprite's skewed silhouette swings from skewX -20 degrees to -62 degrees in 0.4 s (`power2.out`), then rests at -42 degrees.
- Camera: one short linear push (scale 1 to 1.05, drift -10/-8 px, ease `none`) over about 2 s, then still. Travel about 0.07 frame widths.
- Title card fades in over the dimmed set while the set keeps flickering below. No wipes, no spins.

## Camera

Always look down on the world, never at eye level. Paths are monotone, no overshoot.
- High, far, slow push onto a lit stage: the place as a model. Where we are, scene opening, landmark.
- Medium-high three-quarter, near-static drift: two figures sharing a stage. Conversation, handover, choice.
- Lateral tracking with sliding parallax layers: a path through the world. Travel, a journey in steps, a commute.
- Dive low and close to one figure: the toy world gets personal. Tiredness, care, a secret.
- Pull back to the whole lit set: the act spreads outward. Consequence, ending, a season later.
- Fixed wide with only flicker and drift: the finished picture. Title, contact card, closing line.

Characters occupy 1/12 to 1/8 of frame height. Light, glow and tilt band track the subject.

## Signature moves

- Shadows jump when a light is lit: a practical switches on beside sprites and their shadows swing over the floor. For: a shop opening at dawn, a teacher switching on a projector, the first scene of a story.
- Carried light as gauge: a character's small lantern is key light and meter together. For: a long journey in a travel vlog, a history lesson following one messenger, a candle vigil.
- Tilt-shift preciousness: wide frame, sharp band on one tiny subject. For: one stall in a night market, a lone boat in a harbour story, a village on a map.
- Fireflies and moonbeams: soft shafts and drifting dots over a dark path. For: a night walk, a bedtime story, a quiet product reveal.
- RPG grammar: chapter label, named speaker in a dialogue box, a place name, a title card. For: onboarding a new member, history in chapters, a recipe in stages.

## Avoid

- Checkerboard everywhere: the dither band is too wide. Keep it narrow on sprites.
- A lantern that burns out the hand holding it: cap the lighting on sprites and put the glow behind the lantern's centre.
- Unreadable dark scenes: lift mid-tones except in the single beat that must go dark. Text always sits on a band.
- Smooth sprites: never scale pixel art without `pixelated`, never blur a sprite.
- Per-frame blur or full-size canvas redraws: draw the set once and move layers; the tilt-shift is one baked blurred copy.
- Pale brands: the world mixes with `--latar`, so verify the night still reads. Light stays fixed; only materials follow the brand.

# Pixel diorama: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 4.

## hook

- en: establishing diorama at night: the lantern is lit, light pools and shadows jump, the camera pushes in slowly from a high three-quarter angle
- id: diorama malam dibuka: lentera dinyalakan, cahaya menggenang, bayangan melompat, kamera mendorong pelan dari atas miring

## problem

- en: light drops to cold moon and fog; a lone sprite stands small in the dark, the tilt-shift band narrows
- id: cahaya turun ke bulan dingin dan kabut; satu sprite kecil berdiri di gelap, pita fokus tilt-shift menyempit

## fact

- en: a framed dialogue box rises; the line types out letter by letter with the key word in the main colour
- id: kotak dialog berbingkai naik; kalimat diketik huruf demi huruf, kata kunci berwarna utama

## step

- en: the hero walks off along the quay under the lantern, sprites step through frames, shadows swing, the camera holds
- id: tokoh berjalan pergi menyusuri dermaga, sprite berganti frame, bayangan berayun, kamera diam

## compare

- en: two lit spots side by side, warm lantern against cold moon, each sprite in its own pool of light; the camera swings between them
- id: dua titik cahaya berdampingan, lentera hangat melawan bulan dingin, tiap sprite di kolam cahayanya; kamera berayun di antaranya

## number

- en: the dialogue box holds one big figure in metallic caps over a dimmed world, fireflies drifting behind it
- id: kotak dialog memuat satu angka besar berhuruf logam di atas dunia yang diredupkan, kunang-kunang melayang di belakang

## proof

- en: the finished diorama locked in warm light, camera only breathing; sprites idle in place and glints flicker
- id: diorama jadi terkunci dalam cahaya hangat, kamera hanya bernapas pelan; sprite diam bergerak kecil dan kilau berkedip

## offer

- en: the world dims and a metallic title card with ornament and italic tagline fades in over it
- id: dunia diredupkan lalu kartu judul huruf logam dengan ornamen dan tagline miring muncul di atasnya

## cta

- en: title card locked over the dimmed dock, contact in the soft subtitle band, fireflies drifting; held 2 s
- id: kartu judul terkunci di atas dermaga yang diredupkan, kontak di pita subtitle lembut, kunang-kunang melayang; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: pull back to the whole lit diorama, title and ornament locked, glow breathing; held 2 s
- id: kamera mundur ke seluruh diorama berlampu, judul dan ornamen terkunci, cahaya bernapas; diam 2 detik
